segments.ja391:1.1: Dubbaṇṇarūpaṃ tuvamariyavaṇṇī, purakkhatvā [purakkhitvā (syā. ka.)] pañjaliko namassasi;
segments.ja391:1.3: Seyyo nu te so udavā [udāhu (syā. ka.)] sarikkho, nāmaṃ parassattano cāpi brūhi.
segments.ja391:2.1: Na nāmagottaṃ gaṇhanti rāja, sammaggatānujjugatāna [samaggatānujjugatāna (syā.), samuggatānujjugatāna (ka.)] devā;
segments.ja391:2.3: Ahañca te nāmadheyyaṃ vadāmi, sakkohamasmī tidasānamindo.
segments.ja391:3.1: Yo disvā bhikkhuṃ caraṇūpapannaṃ, purakkhatvā pañjaliko namassati;
segments.ja391:3.3: Pucchāmi taṃ devarājetamatthaṃ, ito cuto kiṃ labhate sukhaṃ so.
segments.ja391:4.1: Yo disvā bhikkhuṃ caraṇūpapannaṃ, purakkhatvā pañjaliko namassati;
segments.ja391:4.3: Diṭṭheva dhamme labhate pasaṃsaṃ, saggañca so yāti sarīrabhedā.
segments.ja391:5.1: Lakkhī vata me udapādi ajja, yaṃ vāsavaṃ bhūtapatiddasāma;
segments.ja391:5.3: Bhikkhuñca disvāna tuvañca sakka, kāhāmi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja391:6.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā, bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino;
segments.ja391:6.3: Bhikkhuñca disvāna mamañca rāja, karohi puññāni anappakāni.
segments.ja391:7.3: Nihacca mānaṃ abhivādayissaṃ, sutvāna devinda subhāsitānīti.
